summary: A playable single-player 3v3 MOBA slice: draft one of six original heroes, then play a full match against bots on a symmetric two-lane map with jungle, fog and wards, 32 items, Seals/Cores/Crown Engine, Twin Catalysts and the Aether Colossus, ending in a results screen.
notes: Single-player only: the authoritative 30 Hz simulation runs in the browser behind a command/event protocol; no networking, matchmaking or reconnect. Real-GPU performance and audio were not verified (headless/software rendering only). Camera pans with arrow keys/edge scroll/middle-drag because WASD are ability keys; camera lock is on by default (Y toggles). Bot-only matches take about 20-33 minutes. Restarted from an empty workspace after the first attempt was cancelled by the provider. This build is from the second, uninterrupted run.
